learning_objectives: 2.1 Identify appropriate prompts to elicit textual information: Content gathering, Summarization, Content creation and ideation.

2.2 Identify appropriate prompts to transform content: Reformatting, Editing and proofreading, Providing visualization, Transforming into different media type, Translating, Personalizing/adapting content.
2.3 Identify appropriate prompts to elicit image creation and transformation: Producing image for purpose, Exploring artistic ideas, Transforming an image, Describing image content.

2.4 Identify appropriate prompts to elicit video creation and transformation: Adding motion to images, Interpolating between images, Colorizing B&W movie, Generating video from prompt, Avatar reading script, Adding/removing objects, Automated subtitling.
source_note: Study notes summarized in our own words from the GMetrix course player; not verbatim course text.
structure_note: Mirrors Chapter 1: overview, pre-assessment, three theory topics (2A text, 2B image, 2C video), one quiz per topic, vocabulary, project, post-assessment.
theory_topics: Topic 2A: Prompt Engineering for Textual Information
Topic 2B: Prompt Engineering for Image Generation and Analysis
Topic 2C: Prompt Engineering for Video Creation and Transformation
